[[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]] '''Missile destroyers''' were aquatic anti-air [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] used to patrol waterways around GAR installations. These craft were very effective at destroying enemy aircraft. The Missile Destroyer was later succeeded by the '''Heavy Missile Destroyer'''.
